en: This is my workshop.
If you want to watch, stay well back,
and take your time looking.
note: shared: follows #642 'stay well back,' and #672 'stay well back,' -> 'and take your time looking.'

en: Usually I make pots and farm tools.
Horseshoes, too.
Not that you'd have much use for those, huh?
Anyway, if you spot any, take a good look,
and you'll see what my work is like.
Seen the well on the village's west side?
The finely made one.
I made that, too.
I fussed over every little detail,
so take a good, long look at it sometime.
I heat iron with charcoal.
But there's no charcoal hut near here,
so it's a bit of a struggle.
A blacksmith's training never ends.
You can always see a higher peak ahead.
That's why I love being a blacksmith.
I like you, pal.
Say, those iron tools I've made,

en: You'll see just how skilled a blacksmith I am,

en: Seen anything I've made?
For example, if you flip a horse over,
it's right there, you know.
Huh? Who are you?
You here for something at Halk's workshop?
No, I'm just watching.
I see. Well, watch as much as you like.
Just don't get too close.
If you want to watch,
stay well back,
Whenever iron rang out here years ago,
a kid always came to watch.
He must have loved it.
Since he kept watching like that,
by the time he became a blacksmith,
he thought he could do anything.
But, well, reality
isn't that easy.
He was careless and badly hurt his wife,
and that was how he learned how arrogant he'd been.
Then he mended his ways and learned.
He gave his all to everything, this time,
to really build up his own skill, you see.
Do you think I'm a skilled blacksmith?
Yes, I think so.
In that case,

en: That means all that effort wasn't wasted, either.
note: standalone in msg 30418; the kid = Halk, he is told his effort paid off

en: You can always see a higher peak ahead.
Halk,
I've seen enough of your skill.
So I have a request.
Please help me.
Please lend me your skill at night, too.
, my master, any order from you,
I will carry out without fail.
Setting traps is a pain, too...
Hold it, don't move!
You know this is the trapper Osaida's hut,
and you came in anyway?
I've got traps for big game in here, too.
Wouldn't you be better off not moving rashly?
(Threatening me? You have some nerve, for a human.
You will learn your place in time...)
That's it, just head home quietly.
You again?
You never learn, do you?
Th-that one's...
...Damn it, unless I'm on the job,
I can't catch them
Again
Are you messing with me?
Glad you came. Come on in.
you have traps in your room, don't you?
I've taken every last trap out.
I should still stay on my guard.
Hang on a second...
Damn it.
